dict.string: OptimalRunner reads your heart rate during a run so it can show it on the run screen and record it with your workout.
OptimalRunner saves each run as a workout in Health, including distance, heart rate, and route, so it appears alongside your other activity data.
OptimalRunner uses your location while you are running to measure your pace and draw your route. Location is only used during an active run.
OptimalRunner uses the motion coprocessor to estimate your pace and distance when GPS is unavailable, such as on a treadmill or in a tunnel.
